scope: Controlled virtual EV CAN/ECU HIL research laboratory

requirements.name: vehicle_wheel_speed_consistency
requirements.description: Vehicle speed should remain consistent with available wheel-speed measurements.

requirements.name: accelerator_torque_consistency
requirements.description: Accelerator position and requested motor torque should remain physically consistent.

requirements.name: brake_regenerative_consistency
requirements.description: Brake demand and regenerative braking state should remain consistent.

requirements.name: torque_command_feedback_consistency
requirements.description: Requested and measured motor torque should remain within configured laboratory tolerance.

requirements.name: battery_soc_plausibility
requirements.description: Battery SOC must remain within configured laboratory bounds.

requirements.name: battery_soh_plausibility
requirements.description: Battery SOH must remain within configured laboratory bounds.

requirements.name: hv_voltage_plausibility
requirements.description: HV battery voltage must remain within configured laboratory bounds.

requirements.name: hv_current_plausibility
requirements.description: HV battery current must remain within configured laboratory bounds.

requirements.name: battery_temperature_plausibility
requirements.description: Battery temperature must remain within configured laboratory bounds.

requirements.name: cell_voltage_deviation
requirements.description: Cell voltage deviation must remain within configured laboratory tolerance.

requirements.name: cell_temperature_deviation
requirements.description: Cell temperature deviation must remain within configured laboratory tolerance.

requirements.name: isolation_status
requirements.description: HV isolation status must be valid before the modeled HV system is considered ready.

requirements.name: contactor_state_consistency
requirements.description: HV contactor state must be consistent with modeled system readiness.

requirements.name: precharge_state_consistency
requirements.description: Pre-charge state must be consistent with modeled HV startup sequence.

requirements.name: motor_temperature_plausibility
requirements.description: Motor temperature must remain within configured laboratory bounds.

requirements.name: inverter_state_consistency
requirements.description: Inverter state must remain consistent with motor and VCU state.

requirements.name: charging_connector_consistency
requirements.description: Charging state and connector state must remain consistent.

requirements.name: ecu_heartbeat_presence
requirements.description: Required ECU heartbeat messages must arrive within configured timing limits.

requirements.name: can_message_timing
requirements.description: CAN message inter-arrival times must remain within configured laboratory bounds.

requirements.name: sequence_counter_continuity
requirements.description: Modeled sequence counters should remain continuous.

requirements.name: diagnostic_state_consistency
requirements.description: Diagnostic and gateway states must remain internally consistent.

requirements.name: command_physical_response_consistency
requirements.description: CAN commands should remain consistent with modeled physical response.
